name: markettech-kitchen-store
description: MarketTech Kitchen storefront with Cloudflare Pages Functions, D1 and R2

scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/admin.js && node --check "functions/api/[[path]].js" && node --check "functions/uploads/[[path]].js" && node --check server/auth.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:import && npm run test:storefront && npm run test:auth && npm run test:coupons
scripts.test:applications: node tests/applications.test.mjs && node tests/application-tools.test.mjs && node tests/powerpoint.test.mjs
scripts.test:auth:runtime: wrangler pages functions build --outdir .wrangler/auth-build --compatibility-date 2026-10-24 --compatibility-flags nodejs_compat --minify && node tests/auth-runtime.test.mjs
